native_sequence.fact: UDP receive/pump runs at line145 before owned application-message inspection. After successful GROUPS inspection and owned-message release, lines169-170 queue REQALLENTS, set reqallents_sent and WAIT_ALLENTS, reset request_ms, then break. No second UDP service runs in this call.

send_command serializes then queues reliable, unordered, uncompressed data. Queue copies into Tx entries and assigns packet IDs. Successful queueing contains no sendto call and proves no datagram emission.

A later progress_service samples the same owner before entering the real owner API. Post-queue service count requires the retained queue identity, WAIT_ALLENTS, and DB_CLOSED. Count is service entry, not proof UDP pump or send was reached. Queue-observing service itself is excluded from post-queue sends.

UDP receive/cancel/terminal checks precede pump. Pump checks link/idle/fragment timeouts, iterates Tx in packet-ID order, may queue pure ACK/control, and may retry earlier reliable packets before the new request. Frame-encode or an earlier Tx timeout can return before the request send callback.

__wrap_sendto invokes the real syscall exactly once with unchanged arguments and preserves result/errno. It classifies full return, would-block, interrupted, partial, or other error while an eligible owner service is active. No classification binds a datagram to an application command.

original_source_comparison.fact: Original client pktSendDbg enqueues reliable CLIENT_REQALLENTS. commReqScene then repeatedly commCheck(SERVER_ALLENTS); commCheck monitors receive then lnkBatchSend. Batch send drains retransmission queue before normal send queue. Original source also separates queueing and flushing.

netIdleEx conditionally creates a control idle and batch sends for idle/ACK needs. It may sleep/return under threshold or when disconnected/send queue nonempty. It is not an unconditional request flush contract.

REQALLENTS handler sets REQALLENTS readiness and clears sent_self; later tick may call entSendUpdate(full_update=true), which selects SERVER_ALLENTS, before CLIENT_READY. Original client sends CLIENT_READY only after its ALLENTS wait. READY is therefore not a prerequisite to add in this diagnostic capture. This static original-source path does not prove actual server branch execution or current source association.

SERVER_UPDATE and SERVER_ALLENTS framing remain distinct. Original ALLENTS dispatcher emits a later application full-update ACK before simulation parsing; do not execute it or add that ACK to discover grammar.

timeout_semantics.fact: Caller deadline covers the complete attempt starting before DB/selection/Map work. Map application timeout resets when REQALLENTS queues, but caller deadline does not. Queue and last-service offsets are sampled service times, not precise syscall timestamps.

Role overrides DB/application timeout only. Default link configuration has ping100ms, max_retries8, connect10s, idle30s, fragment10s. Pump checks timeouts before sends; retry exhaustion can terminate before the larger application timeout. Increasing application timeout alone is not a demonstrated repair.
